s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with an onion, thyme, half a chopped scotch bonnet, 1 tsp allspice and 1 tsp curry powder, then cool. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, brush with turmeric water, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

s.note: a taste of home in the snow
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice thin. Fry at 175C until crisp and salt. Mix the juice of 2 limes with a finely chopped red chilli, a pinch of sugar and salt for dipping.

m.how: Blitz 2 scotch bonnets, 2 tsp allspice, thyme, 4 spring onions, 3 garlic cloves and lime juice into a paste. Marinate 4 chicken marylands overnight. Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through. Cook 300g rice with a tin of kidney beans and coconut milk.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 tbsp molasses, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in a ring tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Simmer 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 80ml dark rum and pour over the hot cake. Serve with 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: one sour, two sweet, three strong, four weak
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 limes, 60ml sugar syrup, 180ml Jamaican rum, 300ml pineapple juice and 300ml orange juice. Pour over ice in four glasses and grate nutmeg on top.
